description: LLM Critic rubric for Azure Kubernetes Service operations

checks: Cluster provisioningState is Succeeded or Failed (not empty/null)
kubernetesVersion is a valid AKS supported version
nodeCount and vmSize match the requested agent pool configuration
dnsPrefix and fqdn are present for a successfully created cluster
Delete/stop cluster operations include pre-confirmation show command
No credential or sensitive data in stdout/stderr
AKS cluster deletion warns about node resource group cleanup implications
Scaling to 0 node pools requires explicit confirmation gate
Re-running the same command produces consistent output
Create operations check for resource group existence before cluster creation
Scale operations merge with existing node pool config (not replace)
Delete operations on already-deleted clusters return success (not error)
Command, exit_code, stdout, and stderr are all captured
Timestamp and iteration count are recorded
Cluster state (provisioningState, powerState) before and after operation is documented
kubeconfig retrieval context and credential expiry are logged
All commands include --output json flag
Resource group is specified with --resource-group
--name is provided for cluster operations
Location parameter matches the resource group location when creating
